#--- Outlook: Determine "B" Assessment account
['Outlook',  'Assessment Account'] = S:
   IF ( !Fiscal Period @= DB  ( 'SYS Control', 'Outlook Start', 'String') & ISLEAF () = 1 ,
  # &

  #     DB( 'Below the Line', !Scenario, 'Outlook Periods', !Cost Center, !PL Account, 'USD' )  <> 0,

       'B'| DB ('Below the Line', !Scenario,!Fiscal Period, !Cost Center,  !PL Account, !Below the Line Source, 'Functional Area') |
    IF ( ELISANC ('PL Account', 'OPERDDA', !PL Account) = 1, '0002', '0001'), STET );


  
#--- Outlook: Determine Target Functional Area  
['Outlook',  'Functional Area'] = S:
   IF (  !Fiscal Period @= DB  ( 'SYS Control', 'Outlook Start', 'String') & ISLEAF () = 1 ,
  # &
  #     DB( 'Below the Line', !Scenario, 'Outlook Periods', !Cost Center, !PL Account, 'USD' )  <> 0,
      IF ( ATTRS ('PL Account', !PL Account, 'Functional Area') @<> '', 
            ATTRS ('PL Account', !PL Account, 'Functional Area'),
            ATTRS ( 'Cost Center',!Cost Center,'Functional Area')), 
   STET);

#--- Plan: Determine "B" Assessment account
['Plan',  'Assessment Account'] = S:
#   IF ( !Fiscal Period @= DB  ( 'SYS Control', 'Outlook Start', 'String') & ISLEAF () = 1 ,
  IF ( !Fiscal Period @= ELCOMP('Fiscal Period', 'Plan Update Periods',1) & ISLEAF() = 1,
  # &

  #     DB( 'Below the Line', !Scenario, 'Outlook Periods', !Cost Center, !PL Account, 'USD' )  <> 0,

       'B'| DB ('Below the Line', !Scenario,!Fiscal Period, !Cost Center,  !PL Account, !Below the Line Source, 'Functional Area') |
    IF ( ELISANC ('PL Account', 'OPERDDA', !PL Account) = 1, '0002', '0001'), STET );


  
#--- Plan: Determine Target Functional Area  
['Plan',  'Functional Area'] = S:
#   IF (  !Fiscal Period @= DB  ( 'SYS Control', 'Outlook Start', 'String') & ISLEAF () = 1 ,
  IF ( !Fiscal Period @= ELCOMP('Fiscal Period', 'Plan Update Periods',1) & ISLEAF() = 1,  
  # &
  #     DB( 'Below the Line', !Scenario, 'Outlook Periods', !Cost Center, !PL Account, 'USD' )  <> 0,
      IF ( ATTRS ('PL Account', !PL Account, 'Functional Area') @<> '', 
            ATTRS ('PL Account', !PL Account, 'Functional Area'),
            ATTRS ( 'Cost Center',!Cost Center,'Functional Area')), 
   STET);



#--- Actual: Determine "B" Assessment account
['Actual', 'Assessment Account'] = S:
   IF (   
      DB( 'Below the Line', !Scenario, !Fiscal Period, !Cost Center, !PL Account,!Below the Line Source, 'USD' )  <> 0,

       'B'| DB ('Below the Line', !Scenario,!Fiscal Period, !Cost Center,  !PL Account, !Below the Line Source,'Functional Area')|
  
  IF ( ELISANC ('PL Account', 'OPERDDA', !PL Account) = 1, '0002', '0001'), STET );
